<!doctype html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/><title>Cognitive Aim</title><style>:root{--bg:#06101a;--panel:#091824;--line:#29495a;--cyan:#2be2cf;--mint:#86ffeb;--text:#eef8ff;--muted:#93adba;--bad:#ff756e}*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.wrap{padding:14px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#14344c 0,transparent 35%),var(--bg)}.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:10px}.eyebrow{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--mint)}h1{font-size:21px;margin:3px 0} .sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.pill{border:1px solid #28596a;background:#0d2b36;color:var(--mint);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}.controls{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}.btn{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 13px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.primary{background:var(--cyan);color:#04231f} .secondary{background:#173246;color:#dceaf0;border-color:#2d4c5f}.danger{background:#3b2027;color:#ffc0bb;border-color:#65343d} .btn:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}.hud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}.box{background:#091824;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px}.box span{display:block;font-size:8px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}.box b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:17px} .good{color:var(--mint)}#range{ position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:500px; border:1px solid #355b6e;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;cursor:none;user-select:none;touch-action:none; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(2,11,18,.10),rgba(2,11,18,.10)),url("data:image/webp;base64,
